initialize_model_from_weights: initialize a Caffe2 model from a pickled weights file and broadcast parameters across all GPUs
save_model_to_weights_file: save model parameters and momentum blobs to a pickled weights file for later loading
broadcast_parameters: copy parameter blobs from GPU 0 to all other GPUs in a multi-GPU setup
print_net: print the model network structure showing operator types, input shapes, and output shapes
get_group_gn: calculate the number of groups for GroupNorm based on channel dimensions and config settings
